feeds.title: Triad Moms on Main
feeds.description: Triad Moms on Main is an online parenting resource for the Triad, NC area. Our website launched in October of 2010. We are an all-inclusive resource for parents that features daily blogs, directories, a detailed local events calendar, contests, and giveaways.

feeds.title: Adventures of Frugal Mom
feeds.description: A blog that shares about raising a multicultural family in frugal ways. Hence the name Adventures of Frugal Mom

feeds.title: It's Just Life
feeds.description: I'm Beth. This blog is an extension of my life and while you are here you may read about my travels, my family, see pictures of my teapot collection, a devotional or just simply get a glimpse into my life.

feeds.title: Peanut Butter Runner
feeds.description: Peanut Butter Runner shres fitness tips, health advice and more. I'm Jen and I'm a yoga teacher, fitness professional, and mom to a toddler and two dogs. I live in Charlotte, NC, and share daily updates about food, fitness, yoga, and life.

feeds.title: Love, Jaime Blog
feeds.description: I'm Jaime - an Asheville, NC mom, blogger, and owner of LoveJaime.com. LoveJaime.com is a mixture of tips and stories relating to family, fitness, recipes, crafts, and life in general. I love to create, write and share content that others can relate to.

feeds.title: NC Travel Chat
feeds.description: NC Travel Chat is our North Carolina travel podcast that's a collection of lists and stories of the state's amazing people and places.

feeds.title: Just is a Four Letter Word
feeds.description: My name is Andrea and I'm a travel-loving boymom living in Raleigh, NC. I love making life a little bit easier and a lot more fun by sharing easy recipes, travel tips, and holiday treats.

feeds.title: SobeSavvy
feeds.description: My name is Leslie. I am a Mom and Wife who shares savvy tips and ways to live your best life, via the lifestyle blog, SobeSavvy.com. Family Fun, Food, Travel, Events are just some of the topics you'll find on the blog.

feeds.title: The Boho Diaries Blog
feeds.description: Lifestyle Blog by Nicki Odom. What started as an outlet to share my love of DIY flipping furniture projects, quickly evolved into a space where I share my style choices, DIY decor for the home and entertaining, as well as life momentos of parenting that I never want to forget.

feeds.title: What Mommy Does
feeds.description: My name is Lena. I'm a CPA turned stay-at-home mom of 3 little boogers ages 8, 10, and 13. We live in North Carolina and my kids are in middle school and elementary school. I blog about family finances & help other moms grow businesses.

feeds.title: I'm Fixin' To Blog
feeds.description: Meghan Grant is a North Carolina fashion blogger who writes about home decor, fashion, recipes, and travel.

feeds.title: A Mom's Take
feeds.description: A Mom's Take is a mom blog that started in Phoenix, Arizona on April 1st, 2010 with just one mom trying to connect with others and be a resource for other moms. On this site, you will find a variety of topics from recipes, travel, crafts, gift ideas, blogging tips, and other content to inspire and teach.

feeds.title: Where The Dogwood Blooms
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Cassie. I'm passionate about sharing all the things that make North Carolina living so sweet - the history, the great outdoors, the culture, and the laidback lifestyle.

feeds.title: Go The Adventure Way
feeds.description: We are Justin, Megan, and Silas and we love adventuring this life we have together! Here we share everything travel related whether it's exploring the town we live in, our state, or elsewhere!

feeds.title: So She Writes by Miss Dre
feeds.description: I'm Dre. I'm the mother of three beautiful children and a wife to the coolest, most hard-working guy ever. I'm passionate about sharing my musings on beauty, books, life, love, relationships, music, and style through the written word.

feeds.title: Still Being Molly Blog
feeds.description: Still Being Molly is an ethical fashion & lifestyle blog written by Molly Stillman. You'll find all things lifestyle, ethical fashion, faith, clean beauty, motherhood, and everything in between.

feeds.title: With Style & Grace
feeds.description: I'm Emily. I started this blog back in 2009 when I was pregnant with my oldest daughter. My blog has transitioned from a weekly pregnancy diary to a life and style blog filled with all of the things I love.

feeds.title: Michelle Rogers
feeds.description: Fitness and healthy living for midlife and older adults. My name is Michelle Rogers. On this blog, I hope to help others by sharing my experiences and tips, along with news, workouts, product reviews, original recipes and other helpful resources.

feeds.title: Coffee Beans and Bobby Pins
feeds.description: Coffee Beans and Bobby Pins is North Carolina style blogger Amy, who shares with her readers her love for fashion, style, and much more.

feeds.title: It's Me, Tee
feeds.description: I'm Tiffany. TheMrsTee is a Lifestyle Blog created as a place to share my love of all things Faith, Family, Fashion, Food, Fun, Tech & Travel.

feeds.title: Carolina Mama
feeds.description: Focuses on mom fashion, healthy living, family travel, and more. Malise Terrell is the Owner/Author of the Carolina Mama Blog. She is a popular Raleigh, North Carolina Professional Blogger, Spokesmom, and Social Media Consultant.

feeds.title: B Honest Media
feeds.description: Jessica Lieb is a family lifestyle content creator living in Raleigh, NC with her husband and four sons. She loves to write about meal planning, travel, recipes, and family activities as well as producing family fun videos for her YouTube channel, Lieb Family Adventures.

feeds.title: Life With Emily Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Emily! Life with Emily is a life & style blog based in NC, where I share my personal style, outfit inspo, and my travels, along with bits & pieces of my life.
